record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: Munchlax (1 star) and Snorlax (2 stars), both with passive GLUTTON, declare BODY_SLAM. The strategy is shared; the units differ in stars and stats.
record.summary: Single-target special damage whose requested amount is a star-indexed fraction (0.3 / 0.3 / 0.5 / 0.8) of the CASTER's current maxHP, multiplied by (1 + AP/100) and rounded inside the strategy. The hit is then sent with apBoost = false, so AP is applied once (in the strategy), not twice; crit still multiplies in handleSpecialDamage when the cast crits. No status, movement or heal. The passive GLUTTON raises maxHP (berry, dish, cooking), which therefore raises this damage.

targeting.who: the cast target passed to the strategy (the caster's current target)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; how the target is chosen before the cast was not read.

effects.scaling: requested = round(fraction x caster.maxHP x (1 + AP/100)) in the strategy; handleSpecialDamage gets apBoost = false so it adds no second AP factor; a crit multiplies by critPower (reduced by the target's critReductionFactor) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault is false, so crit needs ABILITY_CRIT). maxHP is the entity's current value (after addMaxHP changes and GLUTTON growth), not the catalog base. Illustration on the catalog base stats only (AP 0, no crit): Munchlax 0.3 x 120 = 36, Snorlax 0.3 x 300 = 90 requested - not measured values.
effects.resolution: requested amount = the rounded fraction of maxHP; applied change = after the optional crit factor, then PokemonState.handleDamage divides by (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF) (ceil, minimum 1), applies shields and other steps; the returned takenDamage is discarded. Blocked (0) by protect / skydiving / magicBounce; a dead or resurrecting target takes nothing.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 0.5 and 0.8 entries are not reachable by the two units' bare star counts (1, 2). maxPP is 100 and range 1 for both.

record.positionalConditions: None read beyond needing a target.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Each cast recomputes from the caster's maxHP at that moment, so damage can grow between casts as GLUTTON raises maxHP.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: fraction 0.3 of the caster's maxHP for both units. Requested amount = round(fraction x maxHP x (1 + AP/100)). Applied: x crit factor on crit, then SPE_DEF division (ceil, min 1) and shields in handleDamage. takenDamage is not consumed.
